name: Moto Traffic Rider: Highway Rush
summary:
Step into high speed VR Bike Racing and become the ultimate moto racer in Moto Traffic Rider: Highway Rush. Ride powerful heavy bikes on busy highway traffic roads filled with cars, buses, and trucks while experiencing immersive VR gameplay, realistic motorcycle simulation, and endless bike racing action

Become a true moto rider, Highway rider, and highway traffic rider as you dodge traffic, perform overtaking, earn near miss bonus points, and feel the thrill of bike racing fever. Built for Moto Traffic Ri
